shortlist.reason: Highest semantic fan-out: one receipt-like image represents documents, manifests, cards, catalog and confirmations.
High semantic fan-out: one memory-card image represents logs, sheets, seals, scanners, drives and presentation material.
A single conductive-seam close-up stands in for several materially different tagged or marked physical objects.
Lowest fan-out but still conflates a physical service key with a service key-card.
